phases.title: Execute Stable Reads Without Re-Deciding Isolation Strategy
acceptance: Execution consumes only execution-ready read handles and cannot re-plan root, latch, epoch, footprint, or reachability strategy.
Physical byte guards are required before dereferencing frames, mmap views, extent windows, or owned read buffers.
Ordinary reads do not hold high-level structural latches across blocking I/O unless the plan and S.6 handoff expose that cost.
phases.instructions: Implement S.5 Phase 6 from the S.5 spec. Separate reachability leases from byte guards and make execution a consumer of lowered plans, not a second planner.
phases.qa_focus: Check for plan/execute conflation, hidden latch-I/O, byte dereference without guards, and retries that secretly reconstruct admission facts.
